task_instance: Implement a minimal idiomatic Elixir OTP deliverable: a supervised GenServer (a simple key/value Agent-style counter) with a proper supervision tree and an async ExUnit test, then compile and run it with mix/ExUnit to verify the tests pass.
blocker_detail: The Elixir/Erlang (BEAM) toolchain needed to compile and run the deliverable is not provided by the runtime: elixir, mix, iex, erl and erlc are all absent, and there is no Elixir version manager (asdf, mise, kerl) present. Writing the source is possible, but the skill's core output (idiomatic OTP code, a working supervision tree, passing ExUnit tests, Dialyzer specs) can only be produced and verified by compiling and running it on the BEAM, which this runtime cannot do. The toolchain also cannot be installed within the permitted install scope: the only install routes available are a system package manager that would require elevated/global installation and a global package-store manager, both of which install outside the work directory and are not the permitted per-project Python-venv or Node-node_modules mechanisms, so no honest install path exists.
evidence: Set up work dir at the task's scratchpad path. Read SKILL.md (elixir-pro: write idiomatic Elixir with OTP/GenServer/Supervisor, Phoenix LiveView, Ecto, ExUnit, Dialyzer, Benchee). The skill references resources/implementation-playbook.md, but no resources/ directory exists next to SKILL.md (only SKILL.md is present). Probes: `which elixir mix erl iex` -> command not found; `elixir --version` -> command not found; `which erl erlc asdf mise kerl` -> all empty; `find / -name elixir -type f` -> none. A system package manager and a global package-store manager are present on PATH, but both would install the toolchain outside the work directory and outside the permitted Python-venv/Node-node_modules install scope, so they were not used. No deliverable could be compiled, run, or verified.
